agent_notes: The English spelling 'Ajeetwana' returns almost nothing directly; the census/administrative spelling 'Ajeetmana' is far better attested (village code 069245, population 1,239 in Lunkaransar tehsil per two independent census mirrors). One Hindi Wikipedia user page gives a detailed founding legend under the spelling 'अजीतराणा' (likely a typo for अजीतवाणा/अजीतमाना) naming founder Ajeetaram of the Dhatarwal clan and listing sister villages (Kheenyera, Soolera, Bheekhnera, Kumbhana, Kolana) that match this unit's own 'nearby' list almost exactly - strong corroboration despite being user-generated content. jatland.com (Dhatarwal, Mahajan, Lunkaransar pages) clearly holds relevant genealogical/founding material per search snippets but blocked WebFetch with 403 on every attempt (www, http, and static mirror all failed - static.jatland.com does not even resolve); a human should browse these directly. No YouTube, Facebook, image, or news source names 'Ajeetwana'/'Ajeetmana' specifically - Patrika's multi-year news series on Mahajan Field Firing Range displacement (2018, 2022x2) is strong regional context (34 villages, 1984-85 acquisition, 3.37 lakh acres) but never lists village names individually, so it is recorded with direct_mention:false. Archive.org's 1962 Rajasthan District Gazetteer (Bikaner) was searched in full text and does not mention Ajeetwana/Ajeetmana at all.
